Context: Demarcation of CGHS covered areas under CGHS Wellness Centre:-

- (ii) The serving Central Government employees residing r0utsi·de the CGHS covered areas shall be covered under CS (MA:) Rules. However, in all CGHS covered cities, the serving Central Government employees residing within the Municipal limits of the city, shall be given a one-time choice to opt for CGHS [instead-of CS (MA) Rules] from the nearest CGHS Wellness Centre.
